extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.49[CR]- Replace the genre grid with one horizontal row of wide image cards, using Amazon navigation artwork where supplied.[CR]- Warm the focused genre and its next neighbour in a separate bounded request lane; retain the chooser until the selected first page is ready.[CR]- Signal return to the selected card directly on the native player terminal callback, before progress reporting and cleanup; remove the fixed one-second return grace.[CR]- Keep fresh In Progress updates after the final provider progress attempt and add stage timings for genre selection and playback return.
